vehicle_documents_expiry_idx.name: vehicle_documents_expiry_idx
vehicle_documents_expiry_idx.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

vehicle_inspections_result_chk.name: vehicle_inspections_result_chk
vehicle_inspections_result_chk.value: overall_result IS NULL OR overall_result IN ('pass', 'pass_with_notes', 'fail')

vehicles_active_vin_uq.name: vehicles_active_vin_uq
vehicles_active_vin_uq.where: vin IS NOT NULL AND status NOT IN ('delivered', 'removed')

vehicles_prices_chk.name: vehicles_prices_chk
vehicles_prices_chk.value: (asking_price IS NULL OR asking_price >= 0) AND (min_price IS NULL OR min_price >= 0)

vehicle_costs_source_uq.name: vehicle_costs_source_uq
vehicle_costs_source_uq.where: source_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'rejected'

appointments_odometer_chk.name: appointments_odometer_chk
appointments_odometer_chk.value: odometer_in IS NULL OR odometer_out IS NULL OR odometer_in >= odometer_out

commission_policies_dates_chk.name: commission_policies_dates_chk
commission_policies_dates_chk.value: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from

customer_interactions_dir_chk.name: customer_interactions_dir_chk
customer_interactions_dir_chk.value: direction IS NULL OR direction IN ('inbound', 'outbound')

customer_wishes_years_chk.name: customer_wishes_years_chk
customer_wishes_years_chk.value: year_from IS NULL OR year_to IS NULL OR year_from <= year_to

leads_payment_pref_chk.name: leads_payment_pref_chk
leads_payment_pref_chk.value: payment_preference IS NULL OR payment_preference IN ('cash', 'bank_finance', 'installments', 'trade_in', 'undecided')

leads_budget_chk.name: leads_budget_chk
leads_budget_chk.value: budget_min IS NULL OR budget_max IS NULL OR budget_min <= budget_max

reservations_deposit_chk.name: reservations_deposit_chk
reservations_deposit_chk.value: deposit_amount >= 0 AND (agreed_price IS NULL OR agreed_price > 0)

installment_allocations_amounts_chk.name: installment_allocations_amounts_chk
installment_allocations_amounts_chk.value: principal >= 0 AND interest >= 0 AND fees >= 0 AND principal + interest + fees > 0

installment_plans_total_chk.name: installment_plans_total_chk
installment_plans_total_chk.value: total_amount = principal + interest_total + fees_total AND principal > 0 AND count > 0

sales_amounts_chk.name: sales_amounts_chk
sales_amounts_chk.value: agreed_price > 0 AND net_amount >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND gross_amount = net_amount + tax_amount AND trade_in_credit >= 0 AND deposit_transferred >= 0

sales_installments_chk.name: sales_installments_chk
sales_installments_chk.value: (payment_type = 'installments') = (financed_amount IS NOT NULL AND down_payment IS NOT NULL) AND (financed_amount IS NULL OR (financed_amount > 0 AND down_payment >= 0 AND down_payment + financed_amount = gross_amount))
